671:t_115:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Your words won't stop us! We've already started running toward the future!」

671:t_116:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Doesn't loving someone mean understanding each other?!」

671:t_116:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you've devoted your life to love, why do you spread your selfishness everywhere?!」

671:t_116:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Truth... $$シンカ$$... So you are the one at its forefront after all.」

671:t_116:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you talking about an $$イノベイター$$'s power?!」

671:t_116:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That power is merely a means to an end! If you haven't grasped that, you still have far to go, Wingless!」

671:t_116:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I shall grant you destruction before you reach your future of despair!」

671:t_116:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「I refuse! You rejected mutual understanding, so you are my... our enemy!」

671:t_116:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「We will get past you and move forward! That is our mission!」

671:t_117:0.en:
$$シン$$
「If you talk about love, don't take someone's life! Everyone lives their own life and loves someone!」

671:t_117:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The love of the Wingless means nothing to me. It was never worth my attention.」

671:t_117:2.en:
$$シン$$
「You! Do you think your feelings are the only thing that counts as love?!」

671:t_117:3.en:
$$シン$$
「We won't let someone like you destroy this world! We'll stop your twisted love!」

671:t_118:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Feelings alone can't do anything, and neither can power alone...」

671:t_118:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「But your feelings are self-centered, and they are driving your power out of control!」

671:t_118:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「An insolent Wingless dares deny my existence as an $$天翅$$?」

671:t_118:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「No one has the right to deny someone else's life...! But if you insist on taking a life... just to suit yourself...!」

671:t_118:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「I won't hesitate to fight! That's the resolve I've made!」

671:t_129:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you hadn't interfered, the $$時の牢獄$$ would have been completed, and that blue planet might have been saved.」

671:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But that would have meant giving up humanity's future in exchange...! The people rejected that!」

671:t_129:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「That is why we fight those who stand in the way of the future!」

671:t_129:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are fools, Wingless... You don't even know how deep the darkness is in the future of despair you face...」

671:t_130:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no reason to accept pity from a mere Wingless.」

671:t_130:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Love has tossed you about, defeated you, and left you struggling in its labyrinth...」

671:t_130:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you truly understood what love means, at least you would never have come to hate anyone.」

671:t_130:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

671:t_130:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You are what I once was...! So I shall cleanse that karma with my own hands!」

671:t_131:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have confirmed the target... My attack target is the black $$アクエリオン$$.」

671:t_131:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You dare challenge these wings of darkness...! Then I shall give you despair!」

671:t_131:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Let me tell you something. We shook that off long ago, and that's why we're here.」

671:t_131:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「There are people who believe in us... That gives me the power to overcome despair.」

671:t_132:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, $$ランカ$$! I'll save you right now!」

671:t_132:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why can't you understand that the more you reach out, the more that girl will suffer?」

671:t_132:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$ has wings that can carry her past that! I believe in them!」

671:t_132:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「They're her songs! Her songs are her very feelings, and they are hope!」

671:t_132:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「As long as she has them, she won't sink into despair! So I'll keep fighting to save her!!」

671:t_132:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then come. I shall show you which is stronger: the hope you speak of, or my despair!」

671:t_132:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sing, $$ランカ$$! Your voice and your feelings will create hope!」

671:t_132:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll protect your songs! That's what I'm fighting for!」

671:t_133:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let all your feelings out! Your hatred, sorrow, pain, and suffering!!」

671:t_133:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You weave the power of life! You dare turn that power against me!」

671:t_133:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's have a jam session! If your song and mine become one, something new is bound to be born!」

671:t_133:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What is with this one...?! Something sets him apart from the other Wingless!」

671:t_133:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Sing, $$ミカゲ$$! And listen to my songggg!!」

671:t_134:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Answer me! Is hurting someone like this what you call the emotion of love?!」

671:t_134:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand what love is...! But watching $$アマタ$$ and the others, I can understand that it's something wonderful!」

671:t_134:3.en:
$$レド$$
「But you're different! You talk about love, yet you want to engulf everyone around you... no, everything in misery!」

671:t_134:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So what? Whether the Wingless's world is destroyed or anything else happens to it is no concern of mine.」

671:t_134:5.en:
$$レド$$
「...I knew it. There must be something wrong with what you call love!」

671:t_134:6.en:
$$レド$$
「And you are my enemy for spreading your selfish desires like that!」

671:t_135:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems the emotion I know as love and what you call love are two different things.」

671:t_135:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Of course they are. An $$天翅$$ and the Wingless cannot possibly be discussed as equals.」

671:t_135:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought so. Your love only brings misery to others, so humans find it hard to understand.」

671:t_135:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I may not look it, but I've learned how wonderful it is to love! I can't believe anyone who knows that would be so destructive, even after losing in love!」

671:t_135:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Therefore, I will eliminate you here!」

671:t_136:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Inheritor. Do you still press on, knowing the future holds despair?」

671:t_136:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes, I do! But I won't let despair engulf the future!」

671:t_136:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We are fighting to fill it with light!」

671:t_136:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Your struggle is futile...! You cannot defeat them!」

671:t_136:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But you've given in to despair and abandoned your own future. You couldn't even defeat us.」

671:t_136:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You do nothing but turn that rage on the world! You're a loser who's turned away from the future!」

671:t_136:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We won't lose to someone like you! We'll teach you that now!」

671:t_137:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I can understand how you feel...」

671:t_137:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You Wingless! Do you mean to pity me?!」

671:t_137:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But I have no intention of accepting what you do.」

671:t_137:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If you intend to end this world, I will fight you.」

671:t_138:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't mind staking everything on love, but you've spread your misplaced resentment and taken it out on far too many people!」

671:t_138:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What could a Wingless understand about me?!」

671:t_138:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Rejecting other people like that only blinds you more to what's around you! Open your heart!」

671:t_138:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Love and hate may be two sides of the same coin, but in your case, hatred has twisted even your love!」

671:t_138:5.en:
$$桂$$
「You won't listen...! Then you've left me no choice!」

671:t_138:6.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll have to stop you by force! Think of it as tough love, you lovesick $$堕天翅$$!」

671:t_139:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you know what it means to love, how can you rob someone of their happiness?!」
